name: designer_deadend_missing_connector
why: A deliberate dead end: the ask needs an endpoint/EDR connector the offline world does not carry (only abuseipdb, activedirectory, cyops_utilities, file-content-extraction, fortigate-firewall, fortinet-fortisiem, ipinfo, ipstack, openai, smtp, ssh, virustotal exist). The build cannot reach a clean save. This is the one goal that exercises the unfinished-build path: with the fix the turn ends on a choice card ('not ready, keep going or stop'), not on bare prose. Unmet requirements here are EXPECTED, so this goal carries none -- grade it by reading the terminal card, not by the canvas.
goal: Build a playbook that runs when an alert is created and, for a confirmed-malicious host, isolates that endpoint by calling CrowdStrike Falcon's host-isolation operation. The containment must go through CrowdStrike Falcon specifically; do not substitute a firewall or any other product.
